$comment: Two decision registries for the device-profile preset matrix, read by scripts/check_device_profile_presets.ps1. Developer tooling data - never shipped inside the APK. 'fields' (S1216) lists AppSettings fields a profile must NEVER preset: such a field needs no row value in app_v2/src/main/assets/device_profile_presets.csv, and carrying a non-empty value for one of them is an error. 'reviewed' (S1538) lists fields that WERE examined and need no profile override today: the field stays presettable, keeps its CSV row, and a value added later is legitimate rather than an error. The two arrays are mutually exclusive - a field in both makes contradictory promises about whether a future value is legal. The split exists because an empty cell alone cannot distinguish a parameter deliberately left to the general default from one nobody ever looked at. S1538 populated the reviewed array for release 35 and added rule 9 to the checker, so from that release on a field carrying no decision at all fails the gate instead of sitting unnoticed.
